title: fix(metadata-protocol)!: an exact `?package=` read answers its own package's item or a 409 naming the holders, and a bare doc read beside two holders serves the environment's own entry
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbBePzY6g11h3hyWk5ud4vWy)_

Fixes #34247
Part of #34248 (delivered here; the area closes it on merge, as with PR #34324)

Contract-review-handoff: review#1 — CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER routed by maintainer order (2026-11-17T12:31Z) · head 1572520e

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: none — no skill teaches a moved answer: `skills/**` teaches `?package=` reads of a holder or of its pair (objectstack-platform SKILL.md, "Customizing an installed package"), which do not move, and never the read of a package that holds no item of the name or the bare doc read beside a package-less entry

> **BREAKING.** Served answers become refusals. `?package=X` of a name X ships no item of, while another package ships it, now answers `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, with `details.candidates` naming the holders (ruling 6917064203 on #34398), on the plain read and `/layers`. A name nothing holds stays 404. The read gate answers before the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal names any holder: a caller the ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience refuses a `doc` gets the gate's 401/403, and a member the list view audience refuses a `view` gets the gate's 403. The bare doc read of a name two enabled packages ship, beside the environment's own package-less entry, now serves that entry instead of the package registered last. ADR-0087 disposition: `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` (in the changeset). No schema key, stored row or registry slot changes.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：带 `?package=X` 读取文档、视图等 8 类元数据时，如果 X 没有这个名字而别的包有，返回 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` 并列出持有包，不再返回别的包的内容；谁都没有的名字仍是 404。`/layers?package=X` 同样处理。文档和视图先过各自的门禁：文档受众门禁拒绝的成员和匿名访问者拿到门禁自己的 403/401，视图受众门禁（`requiredPermissions`）拒绝的成员拿到 403，门禁放行的才拿到 409。两个包都发布同名文档、环境里又有一条无包条目时，不带包名的读取（普通读取、`/layers`、`/published`）返回这条环境条目。Console 文档页和扁平永久链接（跨文档引用都改写到它）在应用包不持有该文档时改为按名字读，跨包引用照常显示，或显示持有包的受众拒绝。
- 为什么改：ADR-0150 D3/D5 规定精确地址只回答该持有者；裁决 6917064203（#34398）定为 409 并列出持有者；裁决 6893582352 规定环境自己的条目优先。原来包名写错的作者会悄悄拿到别的包的内容。
- 风险与回滚：200→409 是收窄（BREAKING），只影响"包名不持有、别的包持有"的地址；环境条目那一行是 200→200 换内容。持有者自己的地址、配对包地址、无包条目、`object`、已覆盖类型、`position`/`capability` 都不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`packages/metadata-protocol/src/protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`（`registryAnswerAtAddress` 的拒绝分支与安全目录排除）、`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`（`gateHolderNamingRefusal`，门禁先于拒绝）、`ui/apps/console/src/pages/DocsSlug.tsx` 与 `doc-address.ts`（按名字回退）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/domains/meta-holder-refusal-audience-gate.test.ts src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts`，预期 58 通过、4 跳过（两个文件合计）；文档门禁拒绝的成员得 403、匿名得 401，视图门禁拒绝的成员得 403，放行者得 409 并列出持有包，`[#34247]` 组在四种装配下非持有包地址返回 409，`[#34248]` 各条在两种注册顺序下三个入口一致。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**#34247 (exact address, X holds no item of the name).** PR #34241 made step 2 of `readMetaItem` decline the metadata service's copy of another package at `?package=X`, for the types the exact qualifier (ADR-0150 D5) does not judge. When X held no item of the name, step 3 still read `getItem`, whose last tier is the first composite across packages, so the address answered another package's item.

Now the code layers' answer at such an address goes through `registryAnswerAtAddress`. An item stamped with another installed package (the same test as `serviceCopyOfAnotherPackage`: not X, not a customization pair either way) is replaced by the registry's package slot for X. When X has no slot:
- If other packages hold the name, the read is refused `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT`, reason `not-held-by-qualifier`, `details.candidates` naming each holder (`notHeldByQualifierRefusal` in `protocol-exact-qualifier.ts`). This is the refusal the covered types already answer, and it uses existing vocabulary only (ruling 6917064203 on #34398).
- If nothing holds the name, the answer is nothing, and the door answers its own 404.
- A qualifier that names no installed package (the Console's app-name segment) gets the same answer (ruling item 3).
- The read gate answers before the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal names any holder (`gateHolderNamingRefusal` in `@objectstack/rest`, asked by both transports' plain read and `/layers` read). For a `doc`, the ADR-0046 §6.7 docs gate judges a doc by its name, so it needs no holder's item: a caller it refuses gets the gate's `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, or `401 UNAUTHENTICATED` when anonymous. For a `view`, the list view audience gate (`filterViewForUser`) judges a view by its body, so every holder the refusal names is read at its own address (a package at its `?package=`, the environment's own item at the address naming no package) and judged: a member it refuses for any one of them gets the gate's `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`. A holder that cannot be read fails closed: both transports' plain read and `/layers` answer the same `500 INTERNAL_ERROR`, which names no holder. A caller the gate admits gets the 409.

The family is the eight types PR #34241 enumerated: `doc`, `view`, `translation`, `field`, `seed`, `datasource`, `external_catalog`, `object_extension`. The security catalog types `position` and `capability` are excluded in code (`isSecurityCatalogType`, ADR-0131 D3). The registry keeps one package holder of such a name, so their code layers' answer is unchanged. A CONTROL pin for each type proves it.

**Aligned in the same direction.**
- `getMetaItemLayered` (`/layers?package=X`): the code layer declines the service's copy of another package and reads X's own item. At an address X holds none of, it gives the same refusal as the plain read (ruling item 2).
- `readCodeLayerForCarryForward` (the save's credential carry-forward, read when no stored row is at the address the save writes): the same decline and the same registry answer, but it **keeps "carries none"**. It does not refuse (ruling item 2 leaves this choice open). The reason: the carry-forward is no read answer. The save door already judges the address on its own path, and a refusal here would turn a save that main accepted into a 409 for a reason the save door never names. Of the family only `datasource` has a credential redactor, so only a datasource save moves. It carried the credential of the package the service kept (or of the first registered holder). It now carries X's own, or none when X ships no datasource of the name.

**#34248 (bare doc read beside a package-less entry).** Take two enabled holders and a package-less entry in the registry's bare slot. The registry exempts the bare doc read from PR #34036's refusal and serves the entry, and so does `MetadataFacade.get`. The protocol's plain read, `/layers` and `/published` served the metadata service's copy instead, which is the holder registered last. Now the environment's entry answers first (ruling 6893582352) on every bare door:
- `refuseAmbiguousBareDocRead` still refuses two holders with no such entry (409, as on main). When an entry sits beside two or more enabled holders, it returns that entry.
- `readMetaItem` step 2 and the layered read decline a package-stamped service copy in that case (`bareDocServiceCopyDisplacesEntry`).
- With no overlay stored, both `/published` doors (`packages/runtime/src/domains/meta.ts` and `packages/rest/src/meta-item-history-routes.ts`, about four lines each, beside the #32183 `mixedOwner` swap) serve the layered read's answer in place of a package-stamped service copy.

**Review M1: the hydrated row as the hydrator lays it.** `hydrateOverlayIntoRegistry` stamps a package-less stored row `_provenance: 'org'` with no `_packageId` (`stateTenantAuthorship`). Such an entry is tenant-authored, so it is never the code layer (#21059). At `989f4ad7` the plain read served the row while `/layers` answered `effective: null`, because the sealed doc's package-less row was declined. Both `/published` doors served 200 with an empty body. Now the layered read lets the environment's row answer when the bare slot holds that row's tenant-authored entry and no code layer (`environmentRowAnswers`: the entry is tenant-authored and `code` is null). `/layers` reports `code: null` with the row as `overlay` and `effective`, and both `/published` doors serve the row, consistent with the plain read. The same row hydrated **after** the artifacts registered (`loadMetaFromDb`, and boot hydration after the artifact door) wears the first registered holder's envelope (`mergeArtifactProtection` grafts it: `_packageId` = first holder, `_provenance: 'package'`). No package-less entry exists then, and the bare doors stay refused 409 naming both, as on main. Both orders are pinned on the composed rig.

**Review S4: a stamp-less entry beside a different stored row.** `environmentRowAnswers` first held for any bare-doc environment entry beside a package-less stored row. With a stamp-less runtime registration (a code layer) and a different package-less stored row, `/layers` `effective` and both `/published` doors moved to the row while the plain read kept the entry. It now holds only where the entry is the row's tenant-authored copy (`code` is null). In the mixed state all three doors serve the registration, with the row as `/layers` `overlay`, as at `989f4ad7`. Pinned in both orders.

**Review S1: one holder beside a stamp-less entry.** I took the minimal option: pin the cell and declare it. The bare doors serve the holder's doc while the registry's `resolveItem` serves the entry. The test is `[measured, unresolved]` and it runs for each one-holder composition. The cell stays out of scope because card #34248's acceptance names two or more holders, and ruling 6893582352 was argued beside two holders. Moving the one-holder cell would change a 200 answer that no card or ruling names. It is declared in the changeset under "Not moved". Follow-up card: #34452 (needs a ruling first).

**Review M2 and ruling item 6: the Console doc doors.** Two Console doors read a doc under the route's package segment, with X as ADR-0048 prefer-local context: the reader (`DocPage`, `/apps/X/docs/BOOK/NAME`) and the flat permalink (`DocsSlug`, `/apps/X/docs/NAME`, which every cross-reference is rewritten to by `doc-links.ts`). The permalink's single-item read (objectui#10188) tells a name the member may not read from an absent one. When either read answers the `not-held-by-qualifier` 409 (X not among the candidates) or a 404, the door now reads the name again by name. Both share one rule, `readsByNameAfter` in `ui/apps/console/src/pages/doc-address.ts`. The result:
- A cross-reference from X's docs to another package's doc renders that doc, as on main.
- The app-name segment of a package that ships several apps (which names no package) renders the doc's one holder, as on main.
- On the flat permalink, a doc the member may not read renders its holder's audience refusal (`DocRefusal`), as on main, for both segment kinds. Before this round it fell to the name-prefix redirect or "Documentation not found".
- A name two other packages ship shows the candidate list (#34070), where main showed one of them by registration order.

A 404 stays the page's "not found" (not turned into a refusal). Opening the single named holder directly is left as the optional follow-up the ruling names.

## FROM → TO

| same address for `view`, `translation`, `field`, `seed`, `datasource`, `external_catalog`, `object_extension` | 200, a holder's item | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` naming the holders |
| `?package=X` of a name no package holds, any of the eight types | 404 | unchanged |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME?package=X` and `/layers`, X ships none, another does, caller refused by the ADR-0046 §6.7 docs audience; both transports | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED` (401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` anonymous): the gate on the holder's doc | unchanged: the gate answers before the 409 |
| `GET /meta/view/NAME?package=X` and `/layers`, X ships none, another does, a member the list view audience (`requiredPermissions`) refuses; both transports | 403 `PERMISSION_DENIED`: the gate on the holder's view | unchanged: the gate answers before the 409 |
| `GET /meta/doc/NAME/layers?package=X`, X ships none, another does | 200, a holder's `code` and `effective` | 409, as the plain read |

| bare `GET /meta/doc/NAME`, `/layers`, `/published`, two enabled holders plus a stamp-less bare entry; both transports, both orders | 200, the holder registered last | 200, the entry (`/layers`: `code` and `effective`) |

| a holder's own address; a pair's address of its base's item; an item bound to no package; `object`; `position` and `capability`; one holder beside a stamp-less entry (measured, unresolved); any other read naming no package | as on main | unchanged |
| the covered types (`action`, `hook`, `job`, `sharing_rule`, `queue`, `assignment_rule`) at a third package | 409 `not-held-by-qualifier` | unchanged |

## Hydration readings (dispatch task 1; review M1)

Measured with the real hydrator on the composed artifact rig (`MetadataPlugin` artifact door plus `AppPlugin`, SQL driver, a stored package-less `sys_metadata` row of a doc two packages ship), on the dispatcher and on `RestServer`, in both registration orders. Scratch test files were not committed.

- **Hydrated after the artifacts** (boot hydration, and `loadMetaFromDb` after the artifact door): the entry carries the first holder's `_packageId` with `_provenance: 'package'`. The bare doors answer 409 naming both. The answer is identical at origin/main `c934631723` and at head `72dc8ca25e`, and it stays so at this head (CONTROL pin). The save door answers 403 `NOT_OVERRIDABLE`, so no new row is stored.
- **Hydrated before the artifacts** (the hydrator's own `_provenance: 'org'` entry): measured at the merge base `6cc3f97465` (main as this PR forks it) and at this head:

  | Door | main `6cc3f97465` | head `de137717ef` |
  |---|---|---|
  | bare plain read, both transports | 200, the holder registered last (`beta doc` with alpha first, `alpha doc` with beta first) | 200, `environment doc` (the row) |
  | bare `/layers` | 200, `code` = the holder registered last, `overlay` = the row, `effective` = the holder registered last | 200, `code: null`, `overlay` and `effective` = the row |
  | bare `/published`, both doors | 200, the holder registered last | 200, the row |
  | each holder's own address | its own doc | unchanged |

  At `989f4ad7` (this PR before the M1 fix) the same state answered: plain read the row; `/layers` `code: null`, `overlay` the row, `effective: null`; both `/published` doors 200 with an empty body. That is the inconsistency M1 named. The head answers are the green pin `[#34248] a hydrated package-less row (hydrated before the artifacts)` in the rig; the M1 ablation turns it red in both orders.
- **The exact address of a non-holder** at main `6cc3f97465`, same rig: `?package=com.qa.gamma` (installed, ships none) and `?package=com.qa.unknown` (not installed) answer 200 with a holder's doc. The plain read gives the first composite (`alpha doc` with alpha first, `beta doc` with beta first). `/layers` gives the service's copy (the holder registered last) as `code` and `effective`. With beta alone shipping, `?package=com.qa.alpha` answers 200 `beta doc`. At this head every one of these answers 409 `RESOURCE_CONFLICT` with `details.candidates` = the holders.

## Ruling item 5: the read gate answers first

Rule: the read gate answers before the `not-held-by-qualifier` refusal names any holder. At `?package=X` of a doc X holds none of, on the plain read and `/layers` of both transports:
- a member the docs audience refuses gets the gate's `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, with no candidates;
- an anonymous caller gets the gate's `401 UNAUTHENTICATED`, with no candidates;
- CONTROL: a caller the gate admits gets the `409 RESOURCE_CONFLICT` naming the holders;
- CONTROL: a doc of the `org` audience gets the 409 for a member.

The same order holds for a `view` at the same address (the list view audience, `requiredPermissions`): a member it refuses gets the gate's `403 PERMISSION_DENIED`, with no candidates; CONTROL: a member it admits gets the 409 naming the holders; CONTROL: at the holder's own address the two members get the gate's 403 and the view. Every holder the refusal names is judged, the environment's own item included: a view only the environment holds answers a member its audience refuses the gate's 403 (CONTROL: an admitted member gets the 409), and a view a package and the environment both hold answers the gate's 403 to a member the package's view admits and the environment's refuses (CONTROL: a member both admit gets the 409).

Pinned in `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-holder-refusal-audience-gate.test.ts`. Its transports and the gate are real; the protocol is a double that throws the protocol's own refusal shape.

## Tests

- `packages/objectql/src/package-scoped-exact-qualifier.test.ts`, the #34247 describe (between the #34040 and #34041 describes; #34354's describe is kept intact after the merge). It contains:
  - the family pin;
  - per type, in both registration orders, the 409 naming both holders at `?package=` of a third installed package and of `com.acme.unknown`, on the plain read and `getMetaItemLayered`, whichever holder's copy the service keeps;
  - one holder: another package's address is refused naming that holder, and the holder reads its body;
  - CONTROLs: a name no package holds is the read's own miss; a pair's read of its base's item and a package-less entry are served; every covered type is still the exact qualifier's 409; `position` and `capability` keep the holder's item (S2);
  - the datasource carry-forward pin with the real redactor.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts` (composed artifact rig, both transports):
  - over four compositions, the non-holder 409 with `details.candidates` on the plain read and `/layers` for an installed and a non-installed package;
  - CONTROL: a name no package ships is 404 at any package address;
  - each holder's own address;
  - the one-holder CONTROL;
  - the S1 `[measured, unresolved]` pin;
  - the #34248 pins: stamp-less entry, hydrated-before-artifacts `_provenance: 'org'` row (M1), a stamp-less entry beside a different package-less stored row (S4: all three doors serve the entry, the row as `overlay`), and the hydrated-after-artifacts CONTROL through the real `loadMetaFromDb`.
- `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-holder-refusal-audience-gate.test.ts` (both transports, the real gate): the gate's 403 for a refused member and 401 for an anonymous caller at `?package=` of a package holding none, on the plain read and `/layers`; CONTROLs: an admitted caller and an `org`-audience doc get the 409 naming the holders. A second describe pins the view gate at the same address on both transports: a member the view audience refuses gets the gate's 403 with no candidates; CONTROLs: a member it admits gets the 409, and the holder's own address answers the two members the gate's 403 and the view. A third describe pins every holder the refusal names, the environment's own item included: a view only the environment holds, and one a package and the environment both hold, each with a refused member's 403 and an admitted member's 409 CONTROL. A fourth describe pins a holder the view gate cannot read: on both transports' plain read and `/layers`, a refused and an admitted member alike get `500 INTERNAL_ERROR` with no candidates; CONTROL: the same address with a holder that reads is the gate's answer (409). The environment-holder pins are driven by candidates the protocol double supplies; for a `view`, the refusal this PR adds names package holders only, so those pins hold the helper's rule rather than a row today's protocol produces (accepted, no contract effect).
- `ui/apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.test.tsx`, "objectstack#34247 — a doc the route's package ships none of is read by name":
  - a cross-reference renders the other package's doc (reads `['com.example.alpha', undefined]`);
  - the app-name segment renders its holder's doc;
  - two holders show the candidate list;
  - CONTROL: the own package is read only at its address;
  - CONTROL: a name nobody ships is not found;
  - the flat permalink (`DocsSlug`), under `WORLD.exact`: a cross-package link to a doc the member may not read renders the holder's refusal (reads `['com.example.alpha', undefined]`), and so does the app-name segment of a multi-app package (reads `['alpha_suite', undefined]`); CONTROL: under the holder's own package it reads that address only.

## Verification

Final head `1572520e` (taken over by seat repo:objectstack#2 from area o1-D). Since `0bc781b5` (L1-c2 delta ACCEPT 6943247306, contract review PASS 6943305789) two commits: `bc6c83bd` merges `main` at `6091b645`, and `1572520e` fixes the one semantic conflict that merge carries.

Why the merge queue ejected `0bc781b5` twice (anchor #34772): `main`'s #34644 (`ddab49de`) added a bare-name fallback to `getMetaItemLayered` (no member named and `code` still null ⇒ `lookupArtifactItem`). The fallback skipped the bare action read's judged answer but not a bare doc read's environment entry (#34248, this PR). So a doc name two enabled packages hold, beside a hydrated package-less row, read the holder registered first as its `code` and `effective` layer on `/layers`, where the plain read serves the row. The two `[#34248] a hydrated package-less row (hydrated before the artifacts)` pins in `meta-disabled-holder-artifact-door.test.ts` (both registration orders) went red, deterministically. `1572520e` makes the fallback skip a bare doc read's environment entry as well; the pins and their assertions are unchanged. Measured on the merged tree before the fix: exactly those two pins red (2 failed, 43 passed); after it: green.
